issues: 近纯黑底 + 灰色细线，整体灰暗无光，点亮之前几乎什么都看不清
画面只有一个词和一个虚线圆，'瞄准'的过程没有内容，1.5s 的等待显得空
点亮只是白字 + 很弱的白辉光，'钉子'落下那一下没有冲击反馈，圆和线也没变化
在 480×270 设计坐标里放大渲染，0.6px 描边与虚线放大后偏糊
changes: look 换 ember（暖黑 · 橙）；按 1920 原生坐标重写：220px / 500 Helvetica Neue 空心字（2px 暖灰描边），r=410 虚线圆 + 内圈 72 格刻度环 + 四个套准刻度
两侧水平虚线带 mono 读数「BEFORE 38 ms」/「AFTER 4 ms」，把'更快'讲成一组对比数据；圆内点亮后升起眉题与 40px 副行
第 54 帧硬切点亮成白热字，同帧圆 / 线锁定成橙色、右侧读数变橙，主圈自转刹停（内圈继续慢转）；白 + 橙两层辉光 8f 衰完、一道冲击环 14f 外扩消散、舞台主光脉冲
保留快慢对比：字急缩 11f（snappy + 按 scale 速度失焦）vs 圆慢收 44f（EASE.out）；描边 44–53f 预热到亮橙白
时长 75→90f，点亮后 hold 36f，全程推进 1→1.015；填充改按帧硬切，不再依赖归一化时间窗
issuesEn: Near-pure black with thin grey lines — dim and unlit; almost nothing is legible before the fill
Only one word and one dashed circle on screen; the 'aiming' phase has no content, so the 1.5s wait feels empty
The fill is just white type with a weak white glow — no impact feedback when the 'nail' lands, and the circle and lines don't react
Rendered from a 480×270 design space and scaled up, so the 0.6px stroke and dashes look soft
changesEn: Look switched to ember; rewritten in native 1920 coordinates: 220px / 500 Helvetica Neue outline (2px warm-grey stroke), r=410 dashed circle + an inner 72-tick bezel + four registration ticks
Horizontal dashed lines carry mono readouts 'BEFORE 38 ms' / 'AFTER 4 ms', turning 'faster' into a before/after data point; an eyebrow and 40px subline rise inside the circle after the fill

Hard cut to white-hot solid on frame 54: the circle and lines lock to orange on the same frame, the right readout turns orange, the main ring stops rotating (inner bezel keeps drifting); a white + orange glow decays in 8f, one shock ring expands and fades over 14f, the stage light pulses
Fast/slow contrast kept: 11f word shrink (snappy + velocity-based defocus) vs 44f circle settle (EASE.out); the stroke warms to bright orange-white over 44–53f
Duration 75→90f with a 36f hold after the fill, push-in 1→1.015; the fill is a frame-based hard cut instead of a normalised time window
